thread:
ashley: Heads-up — Pegasus Networks dedicated cutover is scheduled for tomorrow 23:00 UTC. Need final sign-offs on the change window, version pin, and rollback plan. Customer insists on pin to `redwood-model-server:2.4.1`.
sandeep: I checked the upgrade path — no DB migrations. Env var `PEGASUS_FEATURE_FLAG=false` keeps legacy routing. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/pegasus-dedicated-preflight
liam: SRE note: will add a circuit-breaker at 75% tail latency, and set autoscale cooldown to 5m. Need confirmation on cannibalization policy for other tenants.
jen: CS confirmed customer accepts a 3-hour maintenance window, prefer midnight local but okay with 23:00 UTC if that shortens weekday business impact. They want a public-facing status link during the window.
ashley: OK keeping 23:00-02:00 UTC (3h). Plan: 30m canary at 5% traffic -> 30m ramp to 50% -> full cutover. Smoke test checklist linked in runbook.
olivia: Product requests a canary metric for generation correctness (top-k token drift) + alert if KL divergence > 0.02 vs baseline. Also request pinning for 48h before auto-upgrade.
ashley: Confirmed: pin to 2.4.1 for 48h post-cutover. Rollback plan: revert service to `2.3.7`, invalidate KV cache, redeploy canary config, and backfill traffic with weight routing. If rollback happens, we notify customer and schedule incident postmortem.
deploy-bot: Deploy job created: `deploy pegnet-dedicated v2.4.1 -> cluster-pegasus-01`\nJob ID: db1f3c2\nCanary: 5% for 1800s, health-check: /healthz, success_threshold: 95%\nTo promote: `deploy-bot promote db1f3c2` or rollback: `deploy-bot rollback db1f3c2`
liam: I pushed the circuit-breaker config to the cluster: `kubectl apply -f peg-cb-75.yaml`. Also added a temporary `x-slo` tag so routing respects low-latency allocation during rollout.
ashley: Need two approvals to proceed. @sandeep and @liam can you both ack here? If yes I'll trigger the job at 22:45 so prechecks run before the window.
sandeep: ack
liam: ack
jen: tagging support-oncall for post-cutover monitoring: @support-oncall please watch logs for error spikes for next 6 hours after cutover :eyes:
support-oncall: acknowledged, will monitor and escalate on >5% error rate or latency SLO breach.
ashley: Thanks everyone — scheduling the orchestrated rollout at 22:45 UTC tomorrow. I'll update the customer and post the public status link when live.
